sui: Short thread: we need a firm GA egress policy for Private (default + migrations + operator controls). I want a single-page decision we can attach to the roadmap ticket.

marco: My recommendation: default = shared relay (fast onramp). Add two orthogonal features for GA: 1) declarative egress_profile per tenant (static|burst|dedicated) and 2) a canary switch (percentage-based steering). This lets us control relay capacity while giving customers gradual migration.

veli: Relay default + egress_profile sounds good. For customer-egress we should require an ownership proof flow that doesn't rely on reverse DNS. Idea: issue a short-lived token + URL; customer curls it from their egress IP and we verify source IP matches. Minimal ops for them.

netops-ada: Operations notes: segment relay pools by region and create per-pool quotas. Enforce a minimum static IP request window (e.g., 24h) to prevent churn. Also document IP rotation policy and a telemetry dashboard for pool saturation.

cs-rene: Field request: CS needs an "egress-playbook" artifact showing pre-cutover checklist, expected test URLs, and rollback triggers. Also one-click schedule/cancel from Console.

sui: Proposed fallback semantics: agent probes egress path every 20s; on 3 consecutive failures mark degraded and route to relay. Provide an operator-lock to disable auto-fallback for trusted customers (must be audit-logged).

marco: API sketch (simple):
POST /api/v1/tenants/:tid/egress { "mode":"relay|egress|peering", "profile":"static|burst|dedicated", "egress_ips":["198.51.100.7"], "canary_pct": 5 }
GET /api/v1/tenants/:tid/egress/status -> { "mode":"egress","health":"ok","last_probe":"..." }
Dry-run endpoint required for first opt-in.

veli: Migration safety: drain active sockets for configurable secs, warm caches for 60s, and monitor error_rate + p99 latency. Abort and revert if error_rate increases >0.8% or p99 increases >40ms for 3 consecutive minutes. Those thresholds must be tweakable per-tenant.

netops-ada: Peering is enterprise-only and sales-gated (ASN + contract). For GA we should not accept peering requests without a gating checklist and manual ops sign-off.

cs-rene: Add communication templates for customers: pre-cutover checklist, curl test token instructions, expected behaviour, and escalation contacts. Also a short legal acknowledgement for egress IP registration (prevent abuse).

ops-bot: ops-bot: Draft uploaded: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/egress-policy-one-pager (comments enabled) :robot_face:

sui: Acceptance criteria to attach to roadmap ticket: 1) Relay default + regional pools documented, 2) Egress_profile metadata + canary routing implemented, 3) Customer-egress self-serve with token verification + dry-run, 4) Migration primitives (drain/warm) + rollback thresholds + operator-lock, 5) Console shows per-tenant mode, last_probe, and audit trail, 6) Peering documented and gated for Dedicated.

marco: Action items: I'll write the one-pager + API contract; Veli -> token proof flow + dry-run; Ada -> pool segmentation + alerting; Rene -> CS playbook + legal template. Sui -> attach acceptance criteria to roadmap and schedule a 15m follow-up.

(ended)
